faq.a1: A centralized performance platform for clubs and federations of every sport. Plan training, monitor load, track availability and analyze GPS — for every category, from one place, with one bill.
faq.a2: Yes. The same planning, load and availability tools work for basketball, volleyball, swimming, athletics, rugby and more. Multisport academies run every discipline in one workspace.
faq.a3: Athletes get their plan, wellness check-ins and RPE forms on the mobile app. Staff build and analyze everything on the web platform — the two stay in sync automatically.
faq.a4: On Profesional and Full tiers, ClavaMetrics connects to your existing Catapult or StatSports account and syncs sessions automatically — no CSV exports needed.
faq.a5: The Iniciación tier is free forever for categories under 15 athletes. Every paid tier includes a 14-day trial with no card required.

pr.cmp.sub: Everything in ClavaMetrics, mapped against the four category tiers.
pr.ent.h3: Running 10+ categories or a national federation?
pr.ent.p: Custom contracts for clubs and federations running many categories — consolidated billing, dedicated onboarding, and volume pricing beyond 10 paid categories.
pr.faq.a1: You register one club workspace, then assign a tier to each category from the Admin panel. The Sub-14 can stay on Free while the senior squad runs on Professional. You only pay for the categories that need paid features, billed monthly or annually as one consolidated invoice.
pr.faq.a2: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated to the day. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period — no data is lost, the affected features simply become read-only until you re-upgrade.
pr.faq.a3: Every paid tier comes with a 14-day trial, no card required. The Free tier is free forever for categories under 15 athletes.
pr.faq.a4: Your data stays available for 90 days in read-only mode after cancellation. You can export anything (CSV, JSON, full backup) at any time from the Admin panel. After 90 days the workspace is permanently deleted.
pr.faq.a5: Export a CSV from your GPS or tracking provider and upload it — ClavaMetrics turns it into dashboards and analysis. CSV import is available from the Basic tier up.
pr.faq.a6: One consolidated invoice per club, monthly or annual. We accept credit card, ACH (US), SEPA (EU) and bank transfer for annual contracts over $5K. All invoices are available in the Billing dashboard.

pr.mix.p: You don't pay one fixed plan per club — each category picks its own tier. The Sub-14 stays free while the senior squad runs on Professional. Your bill reflects exactly what each squad uses.
pr.sub: Mix tiers across senior, reserves, and youth — one workspace, one bill, and only what each squad needs. No per-athlete surprises.

testi.intro: Clubs of every size run their performance week on ClavaMetrics — the same tools scale from a single youth category to a full first team.
testi.q1: "We were running four spreadsheets and a WhatsApp group. Now the whole Sub-17 staff plans, logs wellness and tracks load in one place — and it took us an afternoon to set up."
testi.q2: "The ACWR alerts paid for the platform in the first month. We caught two ramp-rate spikes before they turned into soft-tissue injuries — the medical and S&C staff finally read from the same screen."
testi.q3: "Rolling one methodology across every category used to be impossible. With ClavaMetrics our federation sees availability and load for all teams from one dashboard — without taking autonomy from each coach."
